open_points.subject: capture of a failed execution
open_points.text: State 4 says "module:runs owns the conditions of capture, copying the spooled inputs" but its capture step says "module:functions ... only then copies each spooled file into the content-addressed area"; State 3 also assigns the copying to module:functions.
open_points.question: Which module owns and performs the copy of spooled input files into trial fixtures?
options: module:functions performs the copy after module:runs validates the execution and spool
module:runs performs the copy before passing fixture references to module:functions
open_points.default_guess: module:functions performs the copy after module:runs validates the execution and spool

open_points.subject: resume of an unreachable read operation
open_points.text: The resume step says "for a draft-write element that is not a resend after not_applied, the flow activation under which the run started; otherwise the unused approval first, then a grant still active", while A11 says "none for a read" and the read-only flow says a read "asks no authority".
open_points.question: What authority check applies when resuming a read operation that is waiting on service_unreachable?
options: A read requires no authority and is sent again immediately
A read requires an unused approval or active grant under the resume rule
open_points.default_guess: A read requires no authority and is sent again immediately
